header.description: Activation-manifold input for Figure 4 of Wurgaft et al. 2026 (arXiv:2605.05115): one un-intervened forward per prompt of the 49-prompt weekdays pool, saving the layer-28 residual stream at the last token, which the workflow's pca48 step and workflows/scripts/manifold_fig4/manifold_path.py turn into the activation manifold.
